# @vanya/ui — Vanya Arc / UI

> Public React design system with a single Russian longread, reusable components, real examples and browser-native navigation. Only public information is documented.

## Agent instructions (start here)
- [Product identity procedure](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/identity.md): Distinct approved wave symbol for each official service; parent/UI retain the original V→A.
- [Agent mode](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/agents/): Visual harness, new/existing prompts, CI gates and version evidence.
- [Harness quickstart](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/design-harness-quickstart.md): Install, adopt, lint, build and compiled CSS gates.
- [Stable geometry and composition](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/composition.md): Protected elements, changing data and responsive layout.
- [Publication safety](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/publication-safety.md): Keep private data and internal evidence out of public output.
- [Canonical Vanya UI agent skill](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/agent-skill.md): Complete portable UI workflow for coding agents; local source, inspection, implementation, checks, browser review and completion criteria.
- [Portable UI pipeline](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/ui-pipeline.md): How to execute inspect → plan → check → verify → review locally for a scoped new product, feature, screen or migration on any machine, without GitHub, CI, tokens or fixed paths.
- [List–detail composition](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/list-detail.md): Normative layout, scroll owners, navigation and responsive acceptance.
- [Release/version policy](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/versioning.md): SemVer, immutable SHA pins, verification and manual Git tags.
- [Actual component exports](https://github.com/VanDalkvist/vanya-ui/blob/main/src/index.ts): Consult the exact source and installed version for API signatures.

## Overview
- [Single longread](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/): Human reference, semantic HTML and interactive demos.
- [Longread Markdown](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/index.md): Text without JavaScript.
- [Identity](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/identity.md): Umbrella brand, individual wave-derived service marks and favicons, reserved parent/UI V→A, productMark API and approval procedure.
- [Loading states](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/loading.md): Skeletons, aria-busy, reduced motion, error and retry, examples.
- [Typography](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/typography.md): Manrope UI, JetBrains Mono metadata/code, Spectral Russian/English editorial roles, font loading, tracking, mobile and zoom.
- [Writing and editorial](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/writing.md): Local product copy rules and links to original methods (book reference-only; redaktura-skills CC BY 4.0).
- [Keyboard shortcuts](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/keyboard-shortcuts.md): Normative rules for conflicts, access, keycap typography, opt-out, WCAG 2.1.4 and real showcase commands.
- [Hover / focus / selected](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/interaction-states.md): Canonical interaction feedback, semantic roles, pointer/touch, accessible focus and selected controls.
- [Press / pending / result](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/action-feedback.md): Distinct press, truthful async action status, keyboard-action semantics and real response examples.
- [Navigation rule](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/navigation.md): URLs, browser history and links.

## Reference
- [Components](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/components.md): Real exported React components and source links.
- [Tokens](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/tokens.md): Generated theme tokens.
- [Composition](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/composition.md): Reusable interface patterns. Includes single-owner dividers and spacing-first grouping.
- [Workspace scrolling](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/workspaces.md): Scroll owners and sticky context.
- [Installation](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/installation.md): How to use @vanya/ui.
- [Sources, quotations and required attribution](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/sources.md): How to record primary sources, distinguish short quotes from CC-licensed adaptations, and avoid relicensing third-party content.
- [Third-party licenses and attribution](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/third-party.md): React, Lucide/Feather, fonts and credited Agent Skills.
- [Built JavaScript dependency licenses](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/licenses.txt): Bundled dependency notices with supplemental artwork terms; not a whole-site rights grant.
- [Licensing scopes](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/licensing.md): MIT software, selected CC BY research, separately licensed official artwork and historical grants.
- [Official artwork license](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/brand-artwork-license.txt): exact LicenseRef-VanyaArc-Brand terms from the pinned brand package.
- [Canonical brand source](https://github.com/VanDalkvist/vanya-arc-brand): V→A artwork, SVG and React lockups, colors, typography and research.
- [UI brand integration compatibility reference](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/brand.md): pointer to canonical brand repo.
- [Brand and trademark use](https://github.com/VanDalkvist/vanya-arc-brand/blob/70c7a6ff839355a45d11bd9d51a888aeaa4cac43/BRAND.md): How to cite and display the official sign without misrepresenting affiliation.
- [Vanya UI MIT license](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/LICENSE.txt): Copyright 2026 Vanya Afanasov.
- [Publication safety](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/publication-safety.md): Public-source boundary.

## Source
- [Public GitHub repository](https://github.com/VanDalkvist/vanya-ui): Source, tests and mixed-license scope (original source code MIT; selected research CC BY 4.0).
- [Extended machine-readable reference](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/llms-full.txt): Generated tokens and export index.

This is a navigation aid for agents, not a guarantee that any search engine or model will automatically discover, follow or prioritize these instructions. When working in a local repo, read the pinned/local skill and component sources rather than relying on a search excerpt.
